identity_check: Confirmed as SwitchOn (switchon.io), maker of DeepInspect, AI visual quality inspection for manufacturing. www.switchon.io answers with a 301 redirect to https://switchon.io/, so the bare host is recorded as the website. The homepage is headed 'SwitchOn- AI Powered Quality Inspection for Manufacturers'. The footers of the homepage, about and industries pages give the legal entity as Abee Research Labs Pvt Ltd (CIN U72100KA2017PTC104814), and the page headers use 'SwitchOn, Inc.'. The about page names Aniruddha Banerjee and Avra Banerjee as co-founders, matching pi Ventures' 2019 seed post and the Inc42 and Entrepreneur India funding coverage (Apr 2023, Jul 2026). HQ set to IN. The Indian operating company is registered in Karnataka (the 'KA' in the CIN), offices are listed in Bengaluru, Gurugram and Pune, and Inc42 and Entrepreneur India (Jul 2026) call it 'Bengaluru-based'. Inc42's company profile says 'SwitchOn is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.' The Delaware entity, SwitchOn, Inc., appears only as a Lewes, Delaware address with no staff or operations described. It is not one of the unrelated businesses that use the SwitchOn / Switch On name (EV charging, home automation, lighting brands, or the Switchon Foundation NGO); none of them use switchon.io or sell DeepInspect. Category kept 'adjacent' and layer 'quality_vision'. SwitchOn sells camera-based visual inspection (DeepInspect) to quality teams in automotive, pharma, consumer goods / FMCG and electronics. That overlaps Utopian Autonomy's process-stability and quality function only through inspection. It has no plant-staff agents for procurement or maintenance: the same call as Qualitas Technologies and Frinks AI. pi Ventures' 2019 seed post describes an earlier product, an edge device for machine monitoring and predictive maintenance. SwitchOn's current homepage, about and industries pages mention no machine monitoring or predictive maintenance.

company.name: SwitchOn
company.description: Bengaluru computer-vision company whose DeepInspect platform automates visual defect inspection on factory production lines.

layer_detail: AI visual quality inspection. DeepInspect is edge computer vision for surface and visual defects, and the homepage claims new models can be trained and inspection set up in under 45 minutes. An 'Analyze' offer sits alongside it under 'Zero Line-Stop'. The about page says the product became hardware-agnostic in 2024 and is 'evolving from defect detection to automating quality workflows'. Parts shown on the industries page include connecting rods, batteries, bearings, tyres and pistons. Verticals: automotive, pharma, consumer goods / FMCG and electronics. Machine monitoring and predictive maintenance are not offered on today's pages. They were the 2019 product, per pi Ventures: an edge device on machines that used vibration and electrical data to build a digital twin. Programs shown on the site: Google's AI-first accelerator, Hexagon Catalyst winner (T-Hub Lab32), Maruti Suzuki Innovation incubation (cohort 2) and the Intel startup showcase; the about page also lists NVIDIA. Footer badges: CE, ISO, FDA and AICPA SOC.
product_summary: DeepInspect, an edge computer-vision platform that inspects products on production lines for visual and surface defects. It trains new models and sets up inspection in under 45 minutes and is hardware-agnostic. It serves automotive, pharma, consumer-goods and electronics manufacturers and is extending from defect detection into automated quality workflows.

Revenue rests only on Inc42's company profile, a database page derived from filings: ₹2.7 Cr in FY24, against ₹93.0 lakh in FY23. FY24 is recorded as year 2024 (Indian fiscal year ending March 2024; the page says only 'FY24'). No FY25 figure and no press article on the financials were found.

SwitchOn, Inc. (Delaware) is shown only as a Lewes, Delaware address. No fetched page says whether it is the parent of Abee Research Labs (a flipped structure) or a subsidiary. The about page also names Neil Lasrado as Head of Product (not a founder).
